import 'dart:async'; /// A demo class with **markdown** docs. /// See [the docs](https://dart.dev). class Demo extends Base { final String name; final int count = 42; const Demo(this.name); Future<void> run(List<String> items) async { final ratio = 1.5e-3; final raw = r'raw \n string'; final multi = '''multi line'''; final label = 'demo $name'; final map = <String, int>{'a': 1}; if (count > 0 && items.isNotEmpty) { print('$label $count $ratio $raw $multi $map'); } } }
